scope: Scalar synthetic method experiments inspired by the thesis; no reproduction of its complete dual-polarization apparatus or inference of actual hardware port coefficients.
faults: Same five multipliers and seeded location rule as the preceding large-error experiment; labels only enter scoring.
selection: The unchanged 25-point alpha grid from the reference policy is selected using independent noisy validation only; common gain uses training only. No coefficient truth, fault label, or final test data may select algorithms, controls, parameters, or display limits.

aperture.development: The six existing 11.7GHz span5_phase5 healthy/faulted cases may be used to debug implementation; confirmation uses the new seeds only.
aperture.propagation: Consistent exp(-i omega t), outgoing exp(+ikR); backpropagation keeps propagating modes only; centered spatial zero padding factor 3.
aperture.cell: Known staggered geometry; one nonoverlapping 11mm square per element, centered at its physical position; fixed 5x5 Gauss-Legendre quadrature of Fourier-interpolated complex field.
methods: complex region mean with one training-fitted common scale
complex region mean divided by the region response to a known nominal point-model scan
mean amplitude and circular mean phase divided by the same-kind nominal regional reference
aperture.interpretation: Regional aperture quantities are proxies. Scoring them as coefficients is a diagnostic, not an assertion that an aperture average equals feed amplitude. Preserve raw proxies and nominal references.
aperture.validation: No ASM parameter tuning. Ridge alpha uses validation. All methods report independent forward test residuals and relative coefficient scores with the existing evaluation gauge. Interpolation adds no observations.

coded.thesis_pages: PDF 17 / printed 9 literature review; not implemented in thesis chapter 5
coded.status: Project extension inspired by known excitation coding in the literature review.
coded.noise: Each training/validation/test plane uses fixed absolute complex RMS sigma equal to that case's initial uncoded clean plane RMS/100. Each excitation state has independent unit noise. A documented pairing reuses the latent noise between coded and repeated-uncoded alternatives.
coded.budget_control: Compare each K-state full scan with K full scans of unchanged excitation, independently noisy and averaged. Report K times training and validation observation counts; no claim of a free measurement gain.
coded.inversion: Joint nominal-centered ridge of the same unknown hardware error vector with known ideal diagonal patterns; common gain fitted to all training states only.

nonideal_control.provenance: Explicit sensitivity assumptions, not thesis or user chip specifications.

coded.conditioning: Compute singular spectrum of the column-normalized joint matrix. Gram eigendecomposition is allowed only with direct-SVD numerical checks; retain direct SVD for poorly conditioned matrices.
coded.scoring: Original uncoded coefficient vector and independent uncoded test field; unchanged amplitude/phase/complex limits and separate injected-fault scores.

strong_nonideal_control.pairing: Use the same latent per-channel state errors as the mild sensitivity, scaled to the specified standard deviations.
strong_nonideal_control.provenance: Additional explicit stress assumption, not a measured specification of the user chip or thesis hardware.

calibration.thesis_pages: PDF 106-107 / printed 98-99, controller bounds from PDF 57 and 89 / printed 49 and 81
strategies: A then P then AP, with remeasurement
AP then AP then AP, with remeasurement
calibration.estimator: Nominal-centered point-model ridge with training-only gain and independent noisy validation.
calibration.control_eligible: Estimated amplitude at least 0.1 times median estimated amplitude; no injected-fault or coefficient truth used for controls.
calibration.amplitude_control: Attenuate only estimated eligible channels above their current linear-amplitude mean; no extra attenuation for channels below it. Add the new attenuation to the existing command, quantize and clip.
calibration.phase_control: Move eligible estimated phases toward their current circular mean, using accumulated wrapped 64-state commands.
calibration.controller_provenance: Borrowed F6522 control resolution is a simulation assumption, not a claim about the user's unspecified chip.
calibration.cross_talk_provenance: The thesis describes interaction qualitatively; 1 degree per dB is an explicit sensitivity assumption.
calibration.noise: Initial training and validation plane RMS/100 sets each plane's absolute receiver sigma, fixed across all subsequent attenuation states. Distinct plane/round streams, paired across strategies and cross-talk alternatives; observed SNR is reported per round.
calibration.budget: AP once has initial and final measurement rounds; three-update strategies have initial plus three rounds. Each round includes a training and validation scan. Final scoring does not select a stopping round.
calibration.evaluation: Separate normal-channel consistency from reconstruction error. Report all-channel and label-separated metrics, absolute total coefficient power and boresight power versus initial state, coherent efficiency, command saturation and true-fault/normal exclusions. Dead elements remain dead.

reporting.scope: This is method sensitivity evidence, not broad chip reliability or a real-measurement claim.
reporting.visuals: Shared limits for comparable maps; display saturation may improve legibility if limits and clipped counts are disclosed. Never change numerical source values. Visually inspect final figures.

revision.reason: Add a stronger unknown code-state error sensitivity before any confirmation output; runner explicitly confirmed no confirmation run or output yet. Scientific methods, scoring and primary scenarios are unchanged.
